plan.goal: Retrieve a representative protein sequence exhibiting NADPHX epimerase and ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity with Mg(2+) metal ion binding, ATP binding, and an accessible AMP/(6S)-NADPHX binding site by grounding on literature evidence and GO-annotated UniProt family sequences, then confirm biochemical motif presence via sequence analysis.
assumptions: NADPHX epimerase (GO:0035523) is the primary functional constraint; the literature search will surface this GO term and the co-annotated ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (GO:0036429).

Mg(2+) dependence and AMP/(6S)-NADPHX binding are co-annotated in UniProt entries for this enzyme family; sequence_analysis will confirm metal-binding and nucleotide-binding motifs in the retrieved FASTA.
No target scaffold, backbone, or PDB is provided; a representative sequence from the GO-annotated family FASTA is the appropriate in-silico candidate output.
Reviewed UniProt (Swiss-Prot) entries for this activity are sparse; unreviewed TrEMBL entries will be included to reach max_sequences and ensure adequate family coverage.
The top-ranked sequence by annotation density and review status from the sequence_analysis summary will be returned as the output protein sequence.

workflow_plan.description: Retrieve literature for a semantic goal, extract a GO term, collect matching sequences, and summarize the family FASTA.

success_criteria.output_sequence: Single FASTA protein sequence from the NADPHX epimerase family (GO:0035523) with annotated epimerization of S- and R-forms of NAD(P)HX, Mg(2+) coordination, ATP binding, and accessible AMP/(6S)-NADPHX binding site.
success_criteria.family_coverage: At least 10 non-redundant sequences retrieved from GO-annotated UniProt entries covering NADPHX epimerase activity.
success_criteria.annotation_check: sequence_analysis confirms metal-binding residues consistent with Mg(2+) coordination (Asp/Glu/His triad or equivalent) and nucleotide-binding motifs (Rossmann fold or P-loop signature) in the candidate sequence.
